opportunities.name: Unseen recovery strike
opportunities.objective: Use the required unseen recovery interval to ready an Umbral attack on re-entry.
opportunities.mechanic: Passive regenerates stored champion damage while unseen; W grants camouflage and lethality-scaled decaying speed. Umbral now adds a true-damage attack after being unseen, while Edge of Night protects re-entry. Q pull and E return stun can secure one attack before leaving again.
opportunities.requiredState: Take finite champion damage, leave vision, recover, then land one readied attack.
opportunities.failure: Persistent vision prevents recovery/readiness and turns the attack plan into a fragile dive.
opportunities.test: Record unseen duration, gray-health recovery and the first attack packet on return.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Camouflage does not guarantee being unseen near revealing enemies.

opportunities.name: Health-conversion caster
opportunities.objective: Test whether health-bearing AD items improve the execute threshold through passive conversion.
opportunities.mechanic: Pyke converts maximum-health gains at fourteen health per AD. Shojin and Black Cleaver supply health plus AD; Shojin basic haste supports Q/E. R threshold explicitly includes AD[statFormula=2] and Stat(29), while E stun and W speed scale with Stat(29). Compare the conversion against lost lethality.
opportunities.requiredState: Use observed post-conversion AD and lethality, not a fictitious increased health pool.
opportunities.failure: Less lethality may shorten E control and weaken threshold/access despite higher AD.
opportunities.test: Record actual health, AD, W speed, E stun and R threshold before/after each health purchase.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Health purchases do not give Pyke ordinary tank maximum health.

ruledOut.reason: Passive explicitly converts all maximum-health increases into AD, undermining a normal bonus-health tank premise.

unknowns: Stat(29) appears in lethality-oriented formulas but retained identifiers are not silently remapped. Cleaver affects physical pre-execute damage, not execute threshold; support income remains limiting.

testPlan: Required state: Take finite champion damage, leave vision, recover, then land one readied attack.
Record unseen duration, gray-health recovery and the first attack packet on return.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Persistent vision prevents recovery/readiness and turns the attack plan into a fragile dive.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Camouflage does not guarantee being unseen near revealing enemies.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Celestial Opposition, Umbral Glaive, Edge of Night, Eclipse, Youmuu's Ghostblade, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Tap: Pyke stabs, dealing [100 / 150 / 200 / 250 / 300 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to the first enemy hit, preferring champions. They are then Slowed by [90]% for [1] second.

Hold: Pyke throws his harpoon, dealing [100 / 150 / 200 / 250 / 300 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to the first enemy hit and Pulling them towards him. They are then Slowed by [90]% for [1] second.

If Pyke successfully hits an enemy champion or the channel does not complete successfully, [75]% of the Mana cost is refunded.

Pyke stores [0.09 + (0.002) × Stat(29)] of damage taken from champions, increased to [0.4 + (0.004) × Stat(29)] when there's more than one enemy nearby. Pyke can store up to [80 + (8) × AD[statFormula=2]] damage. While unseen by enemies, he rapidly regenerates this stored damage.

Additionally, Pyke converts all Maximum Health increases to Attack Damage instead at a rate of 14 Health to 1 Attack Damage.

Pyke dashes, leaving a drowned phantom behind him that returns to him shortly. The phantom Stuns for [1.25 + (0.01) × Stat(29)] seconds and deals [100 / 150 / 200 / 250 / 300 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to champions.
Pyke gains Camouflage and [45 + (2) × Stat(29)]% Move Speed decaying over [5] seconds.
